The '''RK-392''', simply known as the '''Mobile Tac-Pod''' was a model of [[troop transport]] and [[landing craft]] utilized by the [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]]'s [[Corporate Tactical Forces]], the [[Pre-Mor Authority Security Forces|Pre-Mor Enforcement]], for the deployment of [[Tac-Corpo|corpos]] to planetary surfaces. In [[5 BBY]], a [[Pre-Mor Security Inspection team]] led by [[Deputy Inspector]] [[Syril Karn]] and [[Sergeant]] [[Linus Mosk]] utilized three Tac-Pods to make planetfall on a [[Ferrix City|settlement]] on [[Ferrix]] to [[Ambush on Ferrix|arrest]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Tacpod_cockpit.png|left|thumb|290x290px|The cockpit of the Tac-Pod seated a single pilot and was padded to prevent injuries during atmospheric re-entry]]
The mobile Tac-Pod was a [[troop transport]] and [[landing craft]] used by the [[Pre-Mor Authority Security Forces|Pre-Mor Enforcement]] to deploy [[Tac-Corpo|sentry guards]] from [[BTY-180 carrier]]s to [[planet]]ary surfaces and to provide air-to-ground support to its [[Pre-Mor Security Inspection team|units]]. It was operated by a single [[pilot]] seated in an elevated and padded [[cockpit]] in the front of the craft and had space for at least six standing [[officer]]s in a troop compartment in the back. The crew could enter and exit the Pod through an [[entry ramp]], above which was a notice reading "CAUTION" in [[Aurebesh]].<ref name="Episode 3" /> On the right side of the ship was written "NO-STEP" in Aurebesh.<ref name="2024 Encyclopedia" />

The Tac-Pods were armed with a single [[laser cannon]] placed in a ball mount on the chin, a single barrel turret between the two [[engine]] units on its roof, as well as a fixed cannon located on each of the wing root - just outside of the engine cowling. When in landing configuration, its wings would fold up towards these engines to provide space for the crew to disembark. Although powerful enough to perform atmospheric flights, the engines were not [[hyperdrive]]-capable and the Tac-Pod had to dock on [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]] interstellar vessels to travel from planet to planet.<ref name="Episode 3" /> It had a reinforced hull and reinforced [[transparisteel]] viewport for protection against small arms fire.<ref name="Dawn">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref>

==Role==
[[File:Tacpod_landed.png|thumb|250px|right|A Mobile Tac-Pod on Ferrix]]
Mobile tac-pods were used as landing craft and aerial surveillance platforms in [[City|urban]] operations.<ref name="Episode 3" />

==History==
In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|102}}</ref> after arriving to [[Free Trade sector]] [[planet]] [[Ferrix]] aboard a personnel carrier, a twelve-man Pre-Mor Security Inspection Team led by [[Deputy Inspector]] [[Syril Karn]] and [[Sergeant]] [[Linus Mosk]] utilized three Tac-Pods to descend to their landing zones on a [[Ferrix City|settlement]] believed to house wanted fugitive [[Cassian Jeron Andor]]. In a subsequent [[Ambush on Ferrix|skirmish]], [[North Team]]'s Tac-Pod was destroyed as a [[Brasso|local]] had tied it to a large piece of wreckage, causing it to stall and crash.<ref name="Episode 3" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mobile tac-pod was first pictured in the teaser trailer for [[Andor Season 1|Andor Season One]].<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|j5UX1Adanis|Andor | Teaser Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/andor-teaser-trailer}}</ref> It was first identified four days later in the Summer of [[LEGO Star Wars]] panel in the [[Celebration Anaheim (2022)|2022 Celebration Anaheim]] on [[May 28]], [[2022]].<ref name="LEGO" /> The tac-pod's first on-screen appearance was in the third episode of ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' Season One, [[Reckoning (episode)|Reckoning]].<ref name="Episode 3" />
